investment_thesis.summary: Republic Services is a high-return municipal solid waste and specialty environmental compounder, driving superior EBITDA margins via a 68% internalisation rate, route automation, and the national expansion of its US Ecology environmental solutions network.
return_engines: Core MSW collection and disposal price yield (5.5%-6.5%)
Specialty environmental and industrial waste cross-selling via US Ecology
Landfill RNG gas monetization and fleet electrification/automation efficiency
market_implied_assumptions: Pricing will gradually decelerate toward historical 3.5%-4.0% norms
Recycling commodity weakness will weigh on margin expansion
why_price_may_differ_from_value: Market views RSG strictly as a traditional MSW hauler, overlooking high-margin growth in industrial waste treatment
Operational efficiencies from automated trucks are driving structurally higher long-term FCF conversion

conditions: Core price yield sustains between 5.0% and 6.0%
Severe municipal contract turnover in key metropolitan markets

valuation.explanation: Scenario-weighted normalized earnings model reflecting steady free cash flow compounding, high route internalisation, and resilient disposal moat.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 Earnings Release
catalysts.expected_effect: Confirmation of 5.5%+ core price realization and tuck-in acquisition accretion.

catalysts.name: Commercial Polymer Center Launch
catalysts.expected_effect: Expands value capture in closed-loop PET/polyolefin recycling under EPR laws.

risks: Cost inflation on chassis and specialized technician labor
Subdued containerboard and commodity recycling values
Interest rate headwinds on floating debt tranches
invalidation_conditions: Core MSW pricing drops below operating inflation for three quarters
Loss of major municipal franchise contracts

decision.summary: Republic Services is trading at $208.75, virtually identical to its probability-weighted fair value ($207.03). It is an exceptional business with high recurring cash flow, but disciplined capital allocation mandates waiting for a pullback toward the attractive accumulation threshold ($175.98) before expanding exposure.
